## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The JSON option lookahead should be fixed because a valid invocation requesting both report formats fails.

## Changes
The pull request adds an optional JSON destination, defaults it to `results.json`, and adds report writing and CLI tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON uses its default — For `--json --junit out.xml`, you consume `--junit` as the JSON destination, then raise `ValueError("unknown option: out.xml")`. Both lookahead conditions check only whether another token exists. — Users cannot combine default JSON output with a following JUnit destination, so a valid option order prevents report generation. — Fix: Check the option prefix before both assigning and consuming a JSON destination, as the JUnit parser already does.
